articles.title: Anurag Thakur writes to Himachal CM Sukhu, demands immediate withdrawal of Lottery Tender
articles.description: BJP MP Anurag Singh Thakur has written a letter to Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu on Wednesday, urging the immediate withdrawal of the tender issued by the Finance Department for the reintroduction of state-run lotteries in the state.

articles.title: MP Scraps Stitched Uniform Distribution Plan, To Transfer Uniform Money Directly To Govt School Students Via DBT
articles.description: Madhya Pradesh’s school education department has decided to return to Direct Benefit Transfer for uniform assistance, replacing the proposed distribution of stitched uniforms to government school students. The move follows uncertainty over a roughly ₹350-crore uniform tender that was stayed by the High Court and subsequently cancelled after its intervention.
